A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Retrieve to Explain (R2E) work. All 34 pages of v1 and 35 pages of v2, including Appendices A–U, support reliable comparison of text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original gene-ranking, clinical-trial prediction, evidence-annotation and auditing results, including architectural ablations in Appendix J.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical studies and reports revised clinical-trial results and an additional relative-success comparison in Appendix T.

M1.justification: The Retriever, Reasoner, training objectives, evidence masking, Shapley algorithm and frequency-bias correction are unchanged. The mathematical corrections do not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Held-out Biomedical Literature, Gene Description Facts and Clinical Trial Outcomes, with the same literature/genetics modalities and annotation tasks. Revised corpus and subset counts concern settings within existing coverage.

E2.justification: FREQ, MCS, MLM and the genetics baseline retain their participation in corresponding comparisons. Appendix P revises construction documentation but retains the genetics baseline's maximum MeSH-similarity scoring rule; changed scores alone do not establish a different comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4.5.2 changes the reported genetics evidence corpus from 7,735 to 77,645 sentences, a substantial size revision. Appendix T replaces the 4,762-hypothesis restricted subset with 4,226 hypotheses under an explicit disease-similarity threshold above 0.7, and adds evaluation at an R2E score threshold of 0.6. These change documented settings without establishing that the corpus-size revision involved rerunning experiments.

E4.justification: Appendix T adds an analysis of how many positive therapeutic hypotheses R2E identifies at relative success comparable to the genetics baseline. Existing architectural ablations, temporal-training experiments, modality comparisons and auditing case studies remain.

E5.justification: Both versions already report 95% confidence intervals for relative success and the same de Long significance test. Revised intervals and the newly reported R2E relative-success interval continue that practice; no new estimation procedure, run count or seed information is supplied.

E6.justification: Table 3 changes genetics AUROC from 0.519 to 0.545 while retaining all other scores. Table S9 replaces scores for the revised subset, including genetics 0.544 to 0.588 and combined R2E 0.642 to 0.647; these are not same-setting gains. Figure S4 revises genetics results. Genetics relative success changes from 1.92 to 1.98 with a revised interval; Appendix T adds R2E relative success of 1.98 and 991 positive predictions versus genetics' 500.

T1.justification: Appendix F, Equation 10 changes minus log(Z) to plus log(Z), correcting the softmax-logit relationship. Appendix E changes approximate score reconstruction to exact equality for the sum of attributions plus the NULL score. Equation 9's rewritten normalization term is mathematically equivalent.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions: evidence-driven explainability, updating evidence without retraining, multimodal templating and stronger clinical-trial prediction than the genetics baseline. The additional results support existing claims.

C2.justification: Appendix O corrects the outcome-ascertainment rationale: retained hypotheses without active development now have efficacy that 'could be determined,' replacing 'was yet to be determined.' The exclusion rule, label-noise caveats and principal limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix P replaces its merge2.tsv description with instructions describing the genetics join through pairwise similarities in sim.tsv.gz. Appendix I newly specifies publicly available abstracts. Model hyperparameters, hardware, prompts and resource-release information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 changes the description of SimplEx from its explanatory corpus 'does impact' predictions to 'does not impact' predictions, revising the stated contrast with R2E. The cited works and broader research positioning are otherwise unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized grammatical and punctuation corrections, plus focused rewrites of Appendices P and T. The main narrative and section ordering remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure S4 is replotted with different proportions and moved onto a separate page. Table S9 moves beside Table S10, and Figure S5's caption is clarified. Other figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects Equation 10 and replaces v1's mismatched relative-success estimate and confidence interval. Clearer genetics-joining and subset documentation, together with the additional relative-success comparison, improve correctness and interpretability. These are useful but limited gains: the method, main R2E scores and breadth of validation remain unchanged.
